rule: The whole text of a .env file gives these keys and values, exactly as the dotenv package the bot loads reads it. A line ends only at a line feed, a carriage return, or both together; no other character, however much it looks like a line break, starts a new line.

cases.name: a file with LF line endings
the same file with CRLF line endings reads the same
the same file with CR-only line endings reads the same
the same file without a final line break reads the same
a later line wins over an earlier one for the same key
a line separator and a form feed inside a value do not start a new line
a vertical tab, a next-line character and a paragraph separator inside a value do not start a new line
